verdict.rationale: Sentry documents dashboards and alert rules, and it has a public web API, but the API is only described as managing organizations and teams and exporting data. Nothing in the pack shows dashboards or alerts being defined as JSON models, through Terraform, or via API endpoints for repeatable provisioning. A general reference to the OpenAPI schema covering the full /api/0/ surface does not show that dashboards or alerts can be managed as code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
